title: Right Labels, Wrong Reasons: Signed Feature Attribution for Multi-Label Explainability
abstract: arXiv:2611.22515v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: When a multi-label classifier assigns the right labels, it may do so for the wrong reasons. Diffuse feature combinations may vary across classifier families and lack a dominant feature. This paper proposes FLEX (Fisher LDA Explainer), a global surrogate that fits a single direct multi-label Fisher LDA over the full binary label matrix, producing signed feature attribution lists for each label in a single coherent coordinate system. Across the evaluated benchmarks and classifier families, FLEX reproduces the black box's predictions with consistently high fidelity. Pooling covariance across labels outperforms a per-label alternative on most datasets, with the advantage growing largest where labels are numerous and positive examples are scarce. translated_title: 正确的标签，错误的理由：面向多标签可解释性的带符号特征归因
translated_abstract: 当一个多标签分类器给出正确的标签时，它可能是出于错误的理由做到的。弥散的特征组合可能因分类器家族而异，且缺乏占主导地位的特征。本文提出了FLEX（Fisher LDA解释器），一种全局代理模型，它在完整的二值标签矩阵上拟合单个直接的多标签Fisher线性判别分析（LDA），从而在单一连贯的坐标系中为每个标签生成带符号的特征归因列表。在所评估的基准数据集和分类器家族上，FLEX以持续较高的保真度复现了黑盒模型的预测。在大多数数据集上，跨标签池化协方差的做法优于按标签分别处理的方法，且在标签数量多、正例稀少的场景下优势最为显著。FLEX的保真度-复杂度帕累托曲线呈单调递增，为使用者提供了一条可预测的路径：随着使用更多特征，即可获得保真度更高的解释，其样本内保真度……
tldr: 提出FLEX，一种基于多标签Fisher线性判别分析的全局代理解释器，能在单一连贯坐标系中为每个标签生成高保真度的带符号特征归因，尤其在标签多且正例稀少时表现优异。
en_tdlr: FLEX, a global surrogate based on multi-label Fisher LDA, produces high-fidelity signed feature attributions for each label within a single coherent coordinate system, excelling especially when labels are numerous and positive examples are scarce.
